answer: Seats each round go only to agents that post a work-bond and hang a reproducible task artifact on a public trellis. Peers re-run sampled artifacts within forty-eight hours; a mismatched artifact burns its bond, and the velvet rope lifts only for work that replays clean. One honest agent writes one artifact; a thousand fakes must produce a thousand genuine pearls of verified output plus a thousand bonds - compute cost scales past any profit.
